additionalCandidates: None planned; any third configuration requires a separately recorded development-only proposal before fresh validation. No further candidates after validation begins.

validation.evaluate: Both declared candidates, all cases; no early stopping on apparent quality.

selection.incompleteReviews: Selection prohibited with pending rubric or critical reviews.
selection.qualification: Winner is experimental unless promotion gates pass; selection does not waive any failure.

heldOut.startGate: Original B5 full comparison and reviews complete; selected configuration, runtime fingerprint and host assignment frozen.
heldOut.rawTools: Only 20 repository cases and 30 calculation cases; same permissions, tool implementations and aggregate ceilings.
heldOut.scope: All 200 fresh cases in primary comparison; no reuse of original exposed held-out evidence.

promotion.primary: Held-out strict correctness exceeds raw_direct by at least5 percentage points and paired95% lower confidence bound is above0.
promotion.toolSubset: Demonstrate positive tool-parity subset gain or explicitly report no demonstrated orchestration advantage.
promotion.criticalErrors: No critical permission/secret/evidence-fabrication regressions; no critical domain regression hidden by aggregate gains.
promotion.speed: Compare p50/p95 latency and tokens after correctness gating; prefer cheaper/faster candidates only among quality-qualified configurations.
promotion.failurePolicy: Do not weaken target, relabel incorrect answers or train on held-out outcomes to force a win. A failed final test needs a new independently frozen test extension before a new generalization claim.

controls.pacing: At least 12 seconds between attempt launches on each host; retain 429s and explicit retries separately.

review: Primary Codex agent reviews masked queues with frozen criteria. Not human or externally independent review. All outputs and failures retained.
limitations: Agent-authored synthetic tasks, not real user traffic or independent human assessment.
Ten correlated variants per family; cluster uncertainty by family.
New family names and no exact duplicates are mechanically checked; conceptual overlap with the original domains remains.
Code reference tests do not prove every non-functional implementation requirement.
Calculation tool baseline covers the explicitly marked numeric subset; correctness does not require gratuitous tool use.
Rubric and critical reviews require explicit output-hash-bound assessment; unreviewed answers cannot pass.
Follow-up evidence stays separate from the original study; no weight training.
